name: Commoditization
short_description: Commoditization is the process by which a once specialized, differentiated capability becomes standardized and interchangeable, so that buyers compare providers mainly on price.

evidence.quote: continue to shrink as Microsoft's own native diagnostics commoditize the implementation layer. You can already feel
clients who treat their expertise like a commodity
Generic Microsoft 365 consulting is a race to the bottom that ends in total commoditization.
